description: Single source of configurable runtime flags exposed in System Settings

flags.aggressive_adaptation: Permit stronger adaptation pressure in curated runtime loops
flags.analysis_min_bytes: Minimum output size to qualify for analysis
flags.auditor_prompt_token_budget: Approx token cap for auditor prompt context (0-2000)
flags.autodiscover_deep_skip: Skip deep autodiscovery work on low-value hosts
flags.candidate_partial_followup_bridge: Allow candidate workflow signals with partial success to enter bounded follow-up paths
flags.code000_session_cap: Maximum tolerated code000-like failures within a session window
flags.code000_streak_threshold: Threshold for repeated code000-style runtime failures
flags.confirm_job_cooldown_sec: Minimum seconds between confirm jobs for same target
flags.host_health_cooldown_sec: Cooldown applied when host-health gating suppresses a noisy host
flags.deep_budget_cap_per_host_family: Maximum deep/followup executions per host-family pair before precheck skips further attempts
flags.precheck_burst_cooldown_threshold: Dedup-burst count required before precheck temporarily cools down a noisy host
flags.precheck_burst_cooldown_sec: Cooldown seconds applied after a dedup burst threshold is reached for a host
flags.host_fail_streak_backoff_step_sec: Per-streak sleep step used by precheck when a host has repeated recent failures
flags.host_fail_streak_backoff_cap_sec: Maximum sleep applied by precheck host-fail-streak backoff
flags.transport_observation_cooldown_sec: Cooldown applied when transport-layer 403/code000 observations are first seen for a host
flags.http_403_streak_threshold: 403 streak count required before escalating to a longer host cooldown
flags.http_403_cooldown_sec: Cooldown applied when the 403 streak threshold is reached
flags.code000_session_cooldown_sec: Cooldown applied when code000 session-cap suppression is triggered
flags.context_history: How many recent context entries are passed to pipeline
flags.dual_action_allowed_families: families eligible for safe dual-action attachment
flags.dynamic_plan_adaptation: Allow runtime plan adaptation based on explicit adaptation feedback rather than generic signal counts
flags.early_precision_for_high_leverage_famili: Prefer earlier precision handling for selected high-leverage families
flags.enable_analysis: Enable ANALYSIS stage for high-signal outputs
flags.enable_confirm_jobs: Enable second-step confirmation jobs for confirmable workflow signals
flags.enable_followups: Allow follow-up tasks when workflow-promotion criteria are met
flags.enable_light: Enable LIGHT summary stage for high-signal outputs
flags.evidence_bearing_followup_bridge: Allow promotable evidence-bearing weak signals to continue even when success is not strictly partial
flags.execution_mode: Execution semantics for tool realization: normalized or faithful
flags.experimental_payloads: Enable experimental prompt-shaping for hypothesis-driven payload generation
flags.followup_cooldown_sec: Minimum seconds between queued follow-ups for the same target
flags.family_decay_enabled: Decay repeatedly weak families over time
flags.family_decay_mode: profile wrapper for family decay enablement/window/penalty
flags.family_decay_penalty: Penalty applied to repeatedly weak families
flags.family_decay_window_runs: Number of runs used for family decay evaluation
flags.family_lane_boost: Boost selected task families globally in runtime prioritization
flags.family_lane_suppress: Suppress selected task families globally in runtime prioritization
flags.force_auth_like_weak_on_http_controls: Treat auth-like HTTP control signals as weak qualification evidence unless supported
flags.freeze_plan_revision: Freeze runtime-plan revision even if new signals suggest changes
flags.high_leverage_precision_families: Task families allowed to enter earlier precision handling
flags.json_contract_retries: Max retries for strict JSON contract responses
flags.max_confirm_jobs_per_class: Cap confirmation jobs per classification/finding class
flags.max_confirm_jobs_total: Global cap for queued confirmation jobs
flags.out_of_scope_aggression_cap: single canonical out-of-scope aggression ceiling used by runtime policy
flags.out_of_scope_allowed_aggression: Policy-level allowed aggression ceiling for out-of-scope cases
flags.out_of_scope_max_aggression: Maximum aggression allowed when task is outside scope
flags.plan_adaptation_mode: profile wrapper for runtime plan adaptation vs freeze behavior
flags.planner_reconsult_min_interval_runs: Minimum runs between planner reconsult suggestions
flags.planner_reconsult_mode: profile wrapper for planner reconsult enablement/thresholds
flags.planner_reconsult_on_high_signal: Allow planner reconsult suggestions on adaptation-positive / reconsult-worthy clusters
flags.planner_reconsult_signal_threshold: Minimum adaptation-positive or reconsult-worthy runs before planner reconsult suggestion
flags.policy_diag_logging: Emit verbose policy diagnostics to logs
flags.prompt_token_budget: Approx token cap for per-agent prompt context (0-1250)
flags.qualification_followup_threshold: Minimum verdict to allow follow-up queue admission
flags.qualification_mode: Qualification decision mode: shadow (observe) or enforce (gate runtime)
flags.qualification_promising_threshold: Minimum verdict to mark a run as workflow-promotable
flags.qualification_shadow_workflow_bridge: Allow qualification shadow mode to bridge workflow-promotable signals without enforcing them
flags.qualification_threshold: single operator-facing qualification threshold; raw per-stage thresholds remain as expert overrides
flags.queue_preemption_in_curated_loop: Allow curated-loop queue preemption when higher-priority work appears
flags.safe_dual_action_enabled: allow bounded secondary action attachment for approved dual-action families
flags.strict_deterministic: Prefer deterministic safety behavior over permissive adaptive shortcuts
flags.verbose_commands: Expose built command preview in pipeline output
flags.weak_signal_positive_bridge: Treat weak structured signals as positive legacy-bridge inputs when explicitly enabled
flags.workflow_escalation_profile: profile wrapper for followup/bridge/dual-action workflow escalation
